cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Credit for the Impossible
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you introduce our talking cupboard, announce that I spent a year greeting it while everyone laughed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only said hello back today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. I've approved you crediting my confidence before the evidence arrived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says it would like to introduce itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Permission granted, after my introduction. You may say, 'The person who believed in this conversation before either of you could have it.' Then the cupboard may proceed.

reason: Replace the detached defense of verbosity with a contested public-introduction order; B's request on behalf of the cupboard causes A to grant speaking only after priority credit.
